name: A Tunneler Spindlebind button is saved as Spindlebind (#5469)
contract: AscensionVenomancer::Refresh runs every 500 ms from venomancer_player::OnPlayerUpdate (AscensionVenomancer.cpp:444-448). With the Tunneler talent 630932 ('Your Spindlebind now has 2 charges ... @s:504706') it learns the 2-charge Spindlebind 504706 with learnSpell(..., true) (line 407) and replaces every known Spindlebind rank (chain of 800887) with it through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (lines 402-410). 504706 is never written to character_spell, so a button holding it must be saved as Spindlebind 800887, the spell persisted_action_button reads from Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell; a button holding Spindlebind itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: Tunneler replaces Spindlebind with its 2-charge variant
The bar holds the Tunneler Spindlebind
The Tunneler Spindlebind button is saved as Spindlebind
Control: the Spindlebind button is saved unchanged
